detail: Focused moving-mirror diagnostic review: complete Q17 p4 reread. The gas cloud intentionally removes shape as a clue. Ordinary polarization/spectral/reflection tests may distinguish some configurations, but a universal test of arbitrary fast-moving image versus emitter can depend on unsupplied relativistic Doppler/aberration and can fail for observationally identical sources. No small-speed/model prescription or official worked key resolves the intended requirement. Whole BORDERLINE retained; no invented diagnostic observation.
